name: 销量统计口径 (饲料)
logic: 1. 过滤月份字段 `month_dt`; 2. 默认看饲料销量（d_class_code2 在 '21', '22' 之间）; 3. 统计字段为 `f_sale_num`; 4. 必须剔除澳华内部客户（仅看外部客户）;5.订单状态默认不过滤
sql_snippet: SELECT sum(f_sale_num) FROM alphafeed.dwd_so_saleorder WHERE month_dt = 'YYYY-MM' AND d_class_code2 IN ('21', '22') AND [外部客户过滤条件]

name: 配方
logic: 1. 日期必须用toYYYYMMDD(updt)限制，格式为8位数字，用户不说日期，默认用当前日期，分区用的toYYYYMMDD(updt)=toYYYYMMDD(today）=202606xx 这里用最新日期 别人说年月或者其他格式的你也要自己转化即可，年月则默认用这个日期的最后一天比如2026-05 如果是当月则用today 如果不是则用20260531; 2. 必须选择公司，即d_corp_,用户一般说公司全程或、公司简称，公司编码，也有可能会说模糊字段，即前几个字。比如四会，江门等; 3. 配方d_formula_code和产品d_product_code选填，一般两者选择其一即可，一般也是编码或者名称或者模糊查询;
sql_snippet:
select 
     a.bom_uid  
    ,a.d_corp_code||a.d_product_code||a.d_formula_code||a.bom_version AS tag        
    ,a.bom_version       
    ,a.bom_status        
    ,a.vertion_type      
    ,a.is_default        
    ,a.d_corp_id         
    ,a.d_corp_code       
    ,a.d_corp_name       
    ,a.d_corp_sname      
    ,a.d_product_id      
    ,a.d_product_code    
    ,a.d_product_name    
    ,a.d_product_measure 
    ,a.d_product_type    
    ,a.d_class_code1     
    ,a.d_class_name1     
    ,a.d_class_code2     
    ,a.d_class_name2     
    ,a.d_class_code4     
    ,a.d_class_name4     
    ,a.d_class_code6     
    ,a.d_class_name6     
    ,a.d_formula_id      
    ,a.d_formula_code    
    ,a.d_formula_name    
    ,a.d_formula_measure 
    ,a.d_formula_type    
    ,a.d_row_code1       
    ,a.d_row_name1       
    ,a.d_row_id          
    ,a.d_row_code        
    ,a.d_row_name        
    ,a.d_row_measure     
    ,a.d_row_type        
    ,a.f_ratio_num    
    ,case when b.d_class_code1='2'  then b.f_day_price/1000 else b.f_day_price end as f_day_price
    ,a.f_parent_num       
    ,a.f_row_amount      
    ,a.is_right          
    ,a.formula_date      
    ,a.start_date        
    ,a.end_date          
    ,a.creationtime      
    ,a.creator           
    ,a.modifiedtime      
    ,a.modifier          
    ,a.updt              
    ,a.d_brand_id        
    ,a.d_brand_code      
    ,a.d_brand_name      
from dim_formula_product_day_snap a 
ASOF left join  dws_ia_material_day_stock b
on   b.bill_dt>=left('${BILL_DT}',7)||'-01'
	AND b.bill_dt<=left('${BILL_DT}',7)||'-31'
	and b.f_day_price<>0 --保险开关 如果为0往后找不为0的价格
	and a.d_corp_id=b.d_corp_id
	and a.d_row_id=b.d_material_id
	and a.updt<=b.bill_dt
where a.updt='${BILL_DT}'

   ${IF(LEN(D_CORP_ID) = 0, "", "AND a.d_corp_id IN ('" + D_CORP_ID + "')")}
   ${IF(LEN(D_CORP_CODE) = 0, "", "AND a.d_corp_code IN ('" + D_CORP_CODE + "')")}

   ${IF(LEN(D_FORMULA_CODE) = 0, "", "AND a.d_formula_code IN ('" + D_FORMULA_CODE + "')")}
   ${IF(LEN(D_PRODUCT_CODE) = 0, "", "AND a.d_product_code IN ('" + D_PRODUCT_CODE + "')")}
   

   order by a.d_corp_code ,a.d_product_code desc,a.creationtime desc,a.modifiedtime desc,a.bom_version desc,a.d_formula_code,a.d_row_code

name: 新客户定义
logic: 1. 指本年新开户的客户; 2. 使用维表 `DIM_CLIENT` 中的 `开户日期` 字段判断（具体判断逻辑需结合字段值，通常是本年开户日期）; 3. 该表也可用于区分内外客户。
sql_snippet: SELECT client_id FROM alphafeed.DIM_CLIENT WHERE [open_logic_for_this_year] AND [external_client_logic]

name: 物料
logic:
1. d_class_code1 d_class_code2 d_class_code4 d_class_code6 指的是物料的1 2 4 6位的分类编码; 2. 1开头为原料 2开头为成品 3为添加剂 4为包装物 5为配方 具体如下         ,case when c4.code is null and c2.code='3'  then '3'
               when c3.code='1'  and c2.code='12' then  '3'
               when c3.code='1'  then  '1'
               when c3.code='4'  then  '4'
			   when c2.code='1' then '1'
			   when c2.code is null then c1.code
               else c4.code 
			   end as d_class_code1
         ,case when c4.code is null and c2.code in('3','12')  then '添加剂'
               when c3.code='1'  and c2.code='12' then  '添加剂'
               when c3.code='1'  then  '原料'
               when c3.code='4'  then  '包装物'
               when c4.code='4' then '外袋配件'  
			   when c2.code='1' then '原料'
			   when c2.code is null then c1.name
			   else c4.name
        end as d_class_name1;
sql_snippet: SELECT client_id FROM alphafeed.DIM_CLIENT WHERE [open_logic_for_this_year] AND [external_client_logic]
